children: RNS Number : 1702T  Sealand Capital Galaxy Limited  03 September 2026
For release on Reach: 07.00, 3 September 2026
SEALAND CAPITAL GALAXY LIMITED
("Sealand" or the "Company")
SEALAND LAUNCHES AI-POWERED CONTENT CREATION PLATFORM
MercuryGlitter to support AI-powered advertising, digital media and enterprise content
Sealand Capital Galaxy Limited ("Sealand" or the "Company")
is pleased to announce the launch of MercuryGlitter, a new AI-generated content (AIGC) platform designed to help businesses create and manage high-quality content.

MercuryGlitter has been established through a collaboration between Sealand and an experienced team spanning AI technology and creative management. The platform will operate through MercuryGlitter (HK) Limited, combining the team's expertise in AI technologies, creative production and software engineering with Sealand's international reach, corporate governance framework and strategic oversight.

MercuryGlitter has been designed to support the full content lifecycle, from creative strategy and concept development to AI-assisted production, digital asset management, distribution and long-term operations.
Unlocking AI-Powered Creativity
MercuryGlitter will focus on developing content solutions across a broad range of commercial applications, including:
·      Advertising
·      Brand marketing and promotional content
·      Short-form video production
·      Animation and digital characters
·      Enterprise communications
·      Digital media production

By combining creative expertise with AI-enabled production workflows, MercuryGlitter aims to help organisations improve production efficiency, enhance creative capabilities and accelerate digital content delivery.
Experienced Leadership and Integrated AI Capabilities
MercuryGlitter is supported by a multidisciplinary leadership team combining expertise across creative industries, artificial intelligence, software engineering and commercial operations.

The team is led by Mr Bo Lyu, who has more than 17 years' experience across China's film and television industry. Throughout his career, Mr Lyu has held senior industry positions and participated in the production, distribution and commercialisation of numerous television and film projects. His experience in content development, production management, industry resource integration and commercial operations provides strong commercial leadership for the platform.
The wider team also brings expertise in software systems, distribution and long-term content operations, providing a strong foundation for future growth and international expansion.
Strengthening Sealand's AI Ecosystem

Alongside the Company's activities in computing infrastructure, trusted data infrastructure, enterprise software, digital finance and energy-related technologies, MercuryGlitter expands Sealand's AI capabilities into the application layer.
The Company believes future advances in artificial intelligence will increasingly depend on bringing together the infrastructure, data and applications required to deploy AI effectively at scale.
Daniel Cao, Chief Executive Officer of Sealand Capital Galaxy Limited, commented:
"Artificial intelligence is entering a new phase where competitive advantage will increasingly depend on the ability to transform AI into practical, commercial applications.

MercuryGlitter brings together deep creative industry experience with AI technology and software engineering, giving us a strong foundation from which to build a scalable business in AI-powered content.
This is an attractive and fast-growing segment of the AI market, and one where we believe Sealand can create long-term value for customers, partners and shareholders."
This announcement should be read alongside the Company's recent regulatory announcements.
